labeling_rule: Ordered relevance grades: 3 = exact Davao City multi-constraint/price-ceiling/disambiguation match, 2 = primary intent match, 1 = partial match, 0 = non-relevant or lexical polysemy trap.

disambiguation_schema.lexical_polysemy: Surface token matches brand names in unrelated categories (e.g., 'green' -> Greenwich/Green Coffee vs. healthy greens; '24' -> 24 Chicken vs. 24-hour dining; 'tokyo' -> Tokyo Waffle vs. Japanese).
disambiguation_schema.category_confusion: Overlapping food vs. beverage or dessert vs. meal categories (e.g., milk tea vs. coffee shop, bakery/pastry vs. rice meal restaurant).
disambiguation_schema.spelling_synonym: Davao Bisaya/Taglish vernacular and common culinary misspellings (e.g., kan-anan/karinderya, sinugba/sutukil, sangyup, shwarma, briyani, ramyun).
disambiguation_schema.mixed_intent: Single utterance combining distinct culinary/thematic intents (e.g., pasalubong + durian, wifi study spot + meal).
disambiguation_schema.anaphoric_followup: Multi-turn pronoun/comparative references ('those', 'them', 'the cheaper ones under 180 pesos').
disambiguation_schema.underspecified_ambiguous: Broad colloquial prompts ('date night', 'quick solo lunch') requiring thematic intent resolution.
